company_specific_transmission.operating_demand: AI/HPC end demand and hyperscaler real-compute capex transmit through accelerator/custom-ASIC designs into leading-edge wafer demand and advanced packaging.
company_specific_transmission.capital_productivity: High capex is constructive only while utilization, margins, operating cash flow and FCF validate returns on incremental capacity.
company_specific_transmission.valuation: Elevated real yields and sticky inflation raise the required return and compress the acceptable multiple even when the earnings thesis remains intact.
company_specific_transmission.fx: USD/TWD affects reported translation and ADR/local-share parity; it is an attribution/earnings variable, not a standalone trade signal.
company_specific_transmission.policy: Export controls and industrial policy can directly alter customers, product addressable markets, equipment access, location economics and overseas-fab cost.
company_specific_transmission.geopolitics: Taiwan Strait risk is a persistent risk-premium overlay; verified impairment to production, logistics, power, people, shipping or market access is an immediate re-underwrite/kill trigger.

action_interaction.rule: Macro may change position risk budget, expected-return hurdle and entry attractiveness; company evidence remains primary for thesis validation.
action_interaction.existing_review_zone: $395-$420 first accumulation / buy-review zone if thesis remains intact
action_interaction.not_allowed: No automatic buy/sell from a single macro threshold or price level.
